# statsbridge

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/observe/metrics/statsbridge"
```

Package statsbridge turns each SDK engine's Stats value into a metrics Observer, for metrics.RegisterObservers (#871): Cache (the kernel cache and the data/cache engines on it), Docstore, Forward (app/forward) and Queue (a queue broker's Counter). Each adapts the engine's Stats method value, so the engines know nothing of metrics; every name is kitsunium.\<engine>.\<statistic>, stamped InstanceKey=name when a name is given.
